title: The Landstar Link, Summer 2021
summary: Read about the 2021 Landstar Star Truck Giveaway winner, and awards of all kinds making headlines in the newest edition of Landstar’s Link newsletter.
body_markdown:
The Landstar Link, Summer 2021 newsletter is now available! In this issue, you'll read about:


- The 2021 Landstar All-Star Truck Giveaway Winner
- The Class of 2020 Roadstars and Million Mile Safe Drivers


- A Great Place to Work! Forbes Top 100
- Murphy Brings Home Gold, Silver and Bronze
